newsitem.title: USA: April production steady, slowed by strikes.
newsitem.headline: April production steady, slowed by strikes.

text.p: Production by the nation's mines, factories and utilities was flat in April for the first time since last summer as strikes and related plant shutdowns slowed auto output, the Federal Reserve said on Thursday.

Industrial production was unchanged last month after climbing a smaller-than-previously estimated 0.6 percent in March, the Fed said. It was the weakest showing for the industrial sector since last July, when output also was flat.
